title: German Potato Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired potato casserole, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: german seasoning
ingredients.notes: a blend of salt, pepper, and paprika

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and diced light. Toss to coat.
In a separate pan, sauté the lovely over medium heat until lightly browned.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange half of the potato mixture.
Top with the sautéed lovely and sprinkle with german seasoning.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining potato mixture.
Sprinkle the casserole cheese on top and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
